comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: D'ya see where it says World Map in the upper left-hand corner of this website? A constantly up to date view of GAMA server's world map and town locations is found there. There's also a nifty program called GVONavi that can help you find your way around the game world like GPS with Surveying skill, and shows port locations too. There's probably other things to make navigating the seas easier, but those're what I use!
